text: The regulatory effects of MSTN are present in humans, as exemplified in a case report of an infant who appeared extraordinarily muscular at birth, with protruding thigh muscles (200). The child's development was followed over time, and at 4.5 years of age he continued to display superior levels of muscle bulk and strength. Subsequent genetic analysis revealed that the child was null for the MSTN gene, which conceivably explains his hypermuscularity.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
